svg.title: Bill.com brand mark plate (authored 16x16, shown at 64)
svg.desc: Candidate mark for the Mosofin catalogue, sourced from the MIT-licensed ComposioHQ/open-logos library via composio.dev/toolkits. Raster source (needs a vector redraw before shipping); the art references the sibling file in ../raw/. White plate and #cbd5e1 frame per the containment rule.
